desc:
You need a reliable, affordable scope that still offers top-flight performance-the new Droptine will get the job done. High quality, precision-ground glass is multi-coated to offer superb low light capability with glare resistance. A simple, rugged reticle has holdovers for snap shots at extended ranges. The low-profile turrets are finger-adjustable, and a separate eye piece and power ring allow for flip-up lens caps. Precision internal assemblies are double-spring tensioned for shockproofing, allowing Droptine to survive a lifetime of harsh field use. If anything happens, it's covered by the Burris Forever Warranty.



Technical Information:
"Tube Diameter: 50mm
"Adjustable Click Value: 1/4 MOA
"Exposed Turrets: Yes
"Finger Adjustable Turrets: Yes
"Turrets Resettable to Zero: N/A
"Zero Stop: N/A
"Turret Height: Low
"Fast Focus Eyepiece:
"Lens Coating: Multi-Coated
"Warranty: Burris Forever Warranty
"Rings Included: No
"Sunshade Included: No
"Lens Covers Included: N/A
"Power Variability: Yes
"Min Power: 3x
"Max Power: 9x
"Reticle: Ballistic Plex
"Finish: Matte
"Water/Fogproof: Yes
"Shockproof: Yes
"Eye Relief: 3.1"-3.8"
"Exit Pupil Diameter: 17mm-5.6mm
"Weight: 17 oz.
"Max Internal Adjustment: 30' @ 3x, 11' @ 9x
